title: Don't be government's weapon: Kerala HC advises IAS officer caught in cashew scam contempt case
description: The Kerala High Court on Friday emphasised that Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officers are expected to act with integrity and not blindly act on the government's behest or enable illegalities by the State.
